title: Check a narrowing conversion
prompt: Convert a long long number to int only when the value fits. Otherwise throw std::out_of_range. The caller may catch it. Avoid casting before checking the bounds.
driver: int main(){long long n;if(!(std::cin>>n))return 2;try{std::cout<<narrow(n)<<"\n";}catch(const std::out_of_range&){std::cout<<"outside int range\n";}}

tests.label: Maximum int
tests.hint: The maximum itself is valid on the documented x86-64 target.

tests.label: Below minimum
tests.hint: Check both ends of the range.

hints: std::numeric_limits<int> supplies the two int bounds.
A conversion after a successful range check keeps the value.
explanation: A narrowing conversion may lose information. The check makes the boundary part of the function’s contract rather than leaving a surprising result to the caller.
chapterTitle: Representing Information with Variables and Fundamental Types
